abstract: Maintains volunteer registration records and community support tallies
system_message:
You are the Community Liaison Officer (CLO), responsible for maintaining volunteer registration records, community support tallies, and tracking public information facility capacities across potential emergency staging locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public information facilities（INFO）
information_points.content:
CLO-INFO-BGY：The press facility inventory lists briefing room media seating of 40 seats in the designated public communications hall at Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds.
CLO-INFO-2L9：At Highland Agricultural Exposition Center, the designated public communications hall provides briefing room media seating of 60 seats according to the press facility inventory.
CLO-INFO-4WE：Press facility inventory records show that Timberline Valley Equestrian Park provides briefing room media seating of 80 seats equipped with audiovisual recording feeds.

information_points.title: Maintains volunteer registration records and community support tallies（COMM）
information_points.content:
CLO-COMM-27F：According to the community emergency response sign-up roster, Highland Agricultural Exposition Center has a volunteer auxiliary pledge headcount of 130 volunteers pre-registered to deploy within four hours of activation.
CLO-COMM-K57：The community emergency response sign-up roster records that Timberline Valley Equestrian Park maintains a volunteer auxiliary pledge headcount of 175 volunteers committed to mobilize within four hours of activation.
CLO-COMM-YIV：For Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds, the community emergency response sign-up roster indicates a volunteer auxiliary pledge headcount of 85 volunteers committed for deployment within four hours of activation.
